name: dev-team
description: Test-first squad: the lead owns the spec, the reviewer owns every ticket, one builder writes each criterion's failing test and then its code, and the verifier checks every slice from git

members.role: Owns the spec check and every ticket; judges the tests against the spec and checks from git that each one was committed, and seen to fail, before the code that passes it
Builds a ticket in red-green slices; may add tests, may never weaken one
Documents what a ticket changed, as its last stage
